channel.title: Drive Sorted
channel.description: UK learner driver tips: costs, tests and planning.

item.title: How Many Driving Faults Can You Have and Still Pass?
item.description: To pass the UK practical driving test you can have no serious or dangerous faults and no more than 15 driving faults.

item.title: UK Learner Driver Planner: Lesson Tracker, Costs, Skills and Theory Revision
item.description: Log every driving lesson and its cost, rate 20 skills, plan theory revision and see your budget at a glance. Excel and Google Sheets.

item.title: Theory Test Pass Mark UK: 43 out of 50 and 44 out of 75
item.description: To pass the UK car theory test you need 43 out of 50 on multiple choice and 44 out of 75 on hazard perception. You must pass both parts.

item.title: Learner Driver Costs UK 2026: Licence, Theory and Practical Test Fees
item.description: Provisional licence £34-£43, theory test £23, practical test £62 on weekdays and £75 evenings, weekends and bank holidays. Free learner driver checklist.
